name: OpenClaw Universal Capture
description: Append-only Markdown conversation capture context engine.

folder.description: Workspace-relative folder for daily conversation markdown files.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used for daily rollover and entry times. Defaults to the host timezone.

rolloverTime.description: Local HH:MM time when capture switches to the next conversation day. Defaults to 04:00.

skipNoReply.description: When true, omit turns whose assistant text is exactly NO_REPLY. Defaults to false, so NO_REPLY marker turns are captured.

includeMessageMetadata.description: When true, add inferred agent/surface/channel metadata and senderUsername when present. Defaults to false.

folder.label: Capture Folder
folder.help: Workspace-relative folder for daily Conversation markdown files.

timezone.label: Rollover Timezone
timezone.help: IANA timezone used for daily file rollover and entry timestamps. Defaults to the host timezone.

rolloverTime.label: Rollover Time
rolloverTime.help: Local HH:MM time when capture switches to the next conversation day.

skipNoReply.label: Skip NO_REPLY
skipNoReply.help: When enabled, NO_REPLY marker turns are omitted from the markdown log instead of being captured like normal assistant text.

includeMessageMetadata.label: Include Metadata
includeMessageMetadata.help: When enabled, each entry includes agent, surface, channel, and sender username when available.
